Messages.Author: Thibaut Roulon
Messages.Body:
Hello!

I have a problem with the card "Kiss of Ra". At inferior level,
the vampire burns two blood before blocking. But if it is used at
superior level, does the blocking vampire go to torpor before combat or
after combat ?
If he goes to torpor before combat, is the action still blocked
or can the acting vampire continue with his action ?

Thank you for answers.

Thibaut Roulon.

Messages.Author: L. Scott Johnson
Messages.Body:
Thibaut Roulon <roul...@cti.ecp.fr> writes:
> I have a problem with the card "Kiss of Ra". At inferior level,
>the vampire burns two blood before blocking. But if it is used at
>superior level, does the blocking vampire go to torpor before combat or
>after combat ?

Before (effectively avoiding combat altogether, since combat cannot occur
unless both combatants are ready).

> If he goes to torpor before combat, is the action still blocked
>or can the acting vampire continue with his action ?

The action is still blocked.

>superior level, does the blocking vampire go to torpor before combat or

Steve Bucy

Messages.Author: theCorrupter
Messages.Body:
On Mon, 21 Oct 1996, Thibaut Roulon wrote:

> I have a problem with the card "Kiss of Ra". At inferior level,
> the vampire burns two blood before blocking. But if it is used at
> superior level, does the blocking vampire go to torpor before combat or
> after combat ?
> If he goes to torpor before combat, is the action still blocked

> or can the acting vampire continue with his action ?

Combat is never arrived at. The action modifier resolves immediately
(always the case, barring card text otherwise), afterwords combat _would_
happen, were the vampire not in torpor (one cannot enter combat with a
vampire in torpor). In case anyone else asks, this does not give the
Kissing vampire the attempt to diablerize (no action to do so, no
explicit card text) or play Amaranth (not in combat).
